# Check tooling for the CI workflow, pinned so both Python matrix legs install
# identical versions. Dependabot owns this file (see .github/dependabot.yml);
# every bump arrives as a pull request that has to pass these same checks.
#
# Nothing here is a runtime dependency. The sync scripts use only the Python
# standard library.
ruff==0.17.6
mypy==2.4.1
bandit==1.9.4
# Held back on purpose: coverage 7.17.0 raised its floor to Python 3.11 and the
# matrix still tests 3.10, so no newer release can install on that leg. There is
# no 7.16.3, which makes 7.16.2 the last usable version. dependabot.yml ignores
# anything >=7.17.0 for this reason; drop that ignore when the 3.10 leg retires.
coverage==7.16.2
vulture==2.16
